  "phoneNote": "The framed hero occupies most of the first screen, leaving the shop photography largely below the fold despite a distinctive, coherent visual style.",

  "fixes": [
    "Shorten the phone hero by reducing its padding and olive decoration, and bring a meaningful portion of the shop photo above the fixed action bar.",
    "Reduce the product cards’ height and enlarge the desktop gallery into two balanced columns spanning the content width.",
    "Keep phone and email in the main contact section; simplify the footer to business identity, legal details and utility links."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop footers repeat the phone-and-email contact block immediately after the main contact section."
  ]
